name: Fagus Factory in Alfeld
description: The Fagus Factory in Alfeld, Lower Saxony, is a group of ten buildings that made wooden shoe lasts, the foot-shaped forms used in shoemaking, and it still operates today. Walter Gropius and Adolf Meyer designed it from 1911, giving the main block walls of glass wrapped around the corners with almost no visible support. It looks strikingly modern for its age and anticipates the Bauhaus style.
